Container.Name: homestead
Container.Overview: Shared life app: tasks with take-turns rotation, calendar, and a full-screen iframe app shell for self-hosted services.
Container.Description:
Homestead is a single-container PWA for two-person households. It runs Node 22 + Express + SQLite with no external runtime dependencies.
Features: - Tasks: assign to user A, user B, or both. Recurring chores with an optional take-turns rotation that swaps the assignee every check-off. - Calendar: month grid with per-person colour pips. - Services launcher: editable tile grid that opens your self-hosted services in a full-screen iframe shell inside Homestead, with a draggable escape dot. Each tile can be flipped to "New tab" if a service refuses to iframe cleanly.
Storage: a single SQLite file at /data/life.db. Mount /mnt/user/appdata/homestead from the host to keep data across image upgrades.
Seed passwords (BRANDON_PASSWORD / EMILY_PASSWORD) are only read the very first time the DB is created. After first login each user should change their password in-app; later env changes have no effect.
If you serve Homestead through SWAG (or any TLS-terminating reverse proxy) and want services launched from inside the iframe to work, strip their X-Frame-Options / Content-Security-Policy headers and add `frame-ancestors 'self' https://<your-hostname>`. See the README for the nginx snippet.
GitHub: https://github.com/phattbeats/homestead Image: ghcr.io/phattbeats/homestead

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port mapped to the container's internal 3080.

Config.Name: Data Path
Config.Description: Host path that persists the SQLite database and any future uploads.

Config.Name: SESSION_SECRET
Config.Description: Long random string used to sign session cookies. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32` BEFORE first run; the value is only used to sign cookies and can be set anytime, but rotating it will log everyone out.

Config.Name: BRANDON_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Seed password for the `brandon` user — only used on first DB creation. Change in-app afterwards.

Config.Name: EMILY_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Seed password for the `emily` user — only used on first DB creation. Change in-app afterwards.
